---
title: "Transition and transversion patterns: three marker genes"
format: html
---

This document is the independent three-marker-gene version of step 04. It reads
the existing step-02 concatenated alignment and the existing step-03 identity
table. It never runs MAFFT, selects sequences, or modifies an input file.

```{r}
#| label: load-inputs
library(ggplot2)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

alignment_dir <- file.path("results", "alignments", "three_genes", "concatenated")
identity_dir <- file.path("results", "pairwise_sequence_identity")
output_dir <- file.path("results", "substitution_patterns", "three_genes")
figure_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "figures")
alignment_path <- file.path(alignment_dir, "three_genes.fna")
identity_path <- file.path(identity_dir, "three_genes_pairwise_identity.tsv")
partition_path <- file.path(alignment_dir, "partitions.tsv")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
required <- c(alignment_path, identity_path, partition_path)
if (any(!file.exists(required))) stop("Missing required input: ", paste(required[!file.exists(required)], collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
read_tsv <- function(path) read.delim(path, sep = "\t", quote = "", na.strings = "", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
identity_table <- read_tsv(identity_path)
partitions <- read_tsv(partition_path)
required_identity <- c("genome_group_id_1", "genome_group_id_2", "identical_positions", "compared_positions", "identity_percentage", "compared_fraction")
if (length(setdiff(required_identity, names(identity_table))) > 0L) stop("Step-03 identity columns are incomplete.", call. = FALSE)
```

## Alignment and input validation

```{r}
#| label: validate-inputs
read_fasta <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  h <- which(startsWith(lines, ">"))
  if (!length(h) || h[1] != 1L) stop("Invalid FASTA: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  out <- lapply(seq_along(h), function(i) {
    a <- h[i] + 1L; b <- if (i < length(h)) h[i + 1L] - 1L else length(lines)
    s <- paste(lines[a:b][nzchar(trimws(lines[a:b]))], collapse = "")
    if (!nzchar(s)) stop("Empty FASTA sequence in ", path, call. = FALSE)
    list(header = substring(lines[h[i]], 2L), sequence = s)
  })
  ids <- vapply(out, `[[`, character(1), "header")
  if (anyDuplicated(ids)) stop("Duplicate FASTA headers in ", path, call. = FALSE)
  out
}
records <- read_fasta(alignment_path)
genome_ids <- vapply(records, `[[`, character(1), "header")
sequences <- vapply(records, `[[`, character(1), "sequence")
alignment_lengths <- nchar(sequences)
number_genomes <- length(genome_ids)
if (number_genomes != 520L || anyDuplicated(genome_ids)) stop("Three-gene alignment must contain 520 unique genome IDs.", call. = FALSE)
if (length(unique(alignment_lengths)) != 1L) stop("Alignment sequences have different lengths.", call. = FALSE)
alignment_length <- alignment_lengths[1]
pair_count <- choose(number_genomes, 2L)
if (nrow(identity_table) != pair_count) stop("Unexpected number of step-03 pairs.", call. = FALSE)
identity_keys <- paste(identity_table$genome_group_id_1, identity_table$genome_group_id_2, sep = "\r")
if (anyDuplicated(identity_keys) || any(identity_table$genome_group_id_1 == identity_table$genome_group_id_2)) stop("Step-03 contains duplicate or self pairs.", call. = FALSE)
if (!all(identity_table$genome_group_id_1 %in% genome_ids) || !all(identity_table$genome_group_id_2 %in% genome_ids)) stop("Step-03 contains an unknown genome ID.", call. = FALSE)
if (nrow(partitions) != 3L || !setequal(partitions$gene, c("polh_gran", "lef8", "lef9"))) stop("Invalid three-gene partitions.", call. = FALSE)
partitions <- partitions[match(c("polh_gran", "lef8", "lef9"), partitions$gene), , drop = FALSE]
if (any(partitions$start != c(1L, head(partitions$end, -1L) + 1L)) || partitions$end[3] != alignment_length) stop("Partitions do not span the alignment.", call. = FALSE)
cuni <- sequences[match("AF403738", genome_ids)]
if (is.na(cuni) || any(strsplit(substring(cuni, partitions$start[1], partitions$end[1]), "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]] != "-")) stop("CuniNPV polh/gran exception is invalid.", call. = FALSE)
```

## Pairwise substitution calculations

Only paired A, C, G, and T positions are used. Gaps and ambiguous symbols
are excluded. K2P is calculated from the observed nucleotide counts, not from
the identity table; it is `NA` whenever a logarithm is not mathematically
defined.

```{r}
#| label: calculate-and-validate
pairwise_substitutions <- function(sequences, genome_ids) {
  raw <- matrix(unlist(lapply(toupper(sequences), charToRaw), use.names = FALSE), nrow = length(sequences), byrow = TRUE)
  codes <- as.raw(charToRaw("ACGT"))
  ind <- lapply(codes, function(x) raw == x)
  valid <- Reduce(`|`, ind)
  compared_matrix <- tcrossprod(valid * 1L)
  identical_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(ind, function(x) tcrossprod(x * 1L)))
  transition_matrix <- tcrossprod(ind[[1]] * 1L, ind[[3]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[3]] * 1L, ind[[1]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[2]] * 1L, ind[[4]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[4]] * 1L, ind[[2]] * 1L)
  transversion_matrix <- tcrossprod(ind[[1]] * 1L, ind[[2]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[2]] * 1L, ind[[1]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[1]] * 1L, ind[[4]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[4]] * 1L, ind[[1]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[3]] * 1L, ind[[2]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[2]] * 1L, ind[[3]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[3]] * 1L, ind[[4]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[4]] * 1L, ind[[3]] * 1L)
  ij <- which(upper.tri(compared_matrix), arr.ind = TRUE)
  compared <- as.integer(compared_matrix[ij]); identical <- as.integer(identical_matrix[ij]); transitions <- as.integer(transition_matrix[ij]); transversions <- as.integer(transversion_matrix[ij])
  P <- ifelse(compared > 0, transitions / compared, NA_real_); Q <- ifelse(compared > 0, transversions / compared, NA_real_)
  k2p <- ifelse(compared > 0 & (1 - 2 * P - Q) > 0 & (1 - 2 * Q) > 0, -0.5 * log(1 - 2 * P - Q) - 0.25 * log(1 - 2 * Q), NA_real_)
  data.frame(genome_group_id_1 = genome_ids[ij[, 1]], genome_group_id_2 = genome_ids[ij[, 2]], compared_positions = compared, identical_positions = identical, transitions = transitions, transversions = transversions, transition_frequency = P, transversion_frequency = Q, observed_divergence = P + Q, identity_percentage = ifelse(compared > 0, 100 * identical / compared, NA_real_), ts_tv_ratio = ifelse(transversions > 0, transitions / transversions, NA_real_), k2p_distance = k2p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
substitution_patterns <- pairwise_substitutions(sequences, genome_ids)
new_keys <- paste(substitution_patterns$genome_group_id_1, substitution_patterns$genome_group_id_2, sep = "\r")
if (!identical(new_keys, identity_keys)) stop("Pair order differs from step 03.", call. = FALSE)
if (any(substitution_patterns$identical_positions + substitution_patterns$transitions + substitution_patterns$transversions != substitution_patterns$compared_positions)) stop("Substitution counts do not sum to compared positions.", call. = FALSE)
if (any(abs(substitution_patterns$identity_percentage - identity_table$identity_percentage) > 1e-10, na.rm = TRUE)) stop("Identity values disagree with step 03.", call. = FALSE)
if (any(abs(substitution_patterns$observed_divergence - (1 - substitution_patterns$identity_percentage / 100)) > 1e-12, na.rm = TRUE)) stop("Observed divergence is inconsistent with identity.", call. = FALSE)
if (any(substitution_patterns$transition_frequency < 0 | substitution_patterns$transition_frequency > 1 | substitution_patterns$transversion_frequency < 0 | substitution_patterns$transversion_frequency > 1, na.rm = TRUE)) stop("Invalid substitution frequencies.", call. = FALSE)
write.table(substitution_patterns, file.path(output_dir, "pairwise_substitution_patterns.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

## Figures

```{r}
#| label: create-figures
plot_font_size <- 14; plot_width <- 25.17; plot_height <- 10.5; dpi <- 300
theme_plot <- theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") + theme(axis.text = element_text(size = plot_font_size), axis.title = element_text(size = plot_font_size), legend.position = "top", panel.grid = element_blank())
colours <- c("Transitions" = "#0000FF", "Transversions" = "#FF0000")
long <- rbind(data.frame(identity_percentage = substitution_patterns$identity_percentage, frequency = substitution_patterns$transition_frequency, type = "Transitions"), data.frame(identity_percentage = substitution_patterns$identity_percentage, frequency = substitution_patterns$transversion_frequency, type = "Transversions"))
xlow <- floor(min(long$identity_percentage, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
plot_substitutions <- ggplot(long, aes(identity_percentage, frequency, colour = type)) + geom_point(alpha = .12, size = .7) + scale_colour_manual(values = colours) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(xlow, 100), breaks = seq(xlow, 100, 10), expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, .4, .1), labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, .4), expand = c(0, 0)) + labs(x = "Pairwise nucleotide sequence identity (%)", y = "Observed nucleotide differences (%)", colour = NULL) + theme_plot
plot_substitutions_zoom <- plot_substitutions + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(80, 100), ylim = c(0, .15)) + theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "transitions_transversions.png"), plot_substitutions, width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "transitions_transversions_zoom.png"), plot_substitutions_zoom, width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")

bins <- cut(substitution_patterns$identity_percentage, breaks = seq(0, 101, 1), include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE)
ratio_summary_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(levels(bins)), function(i) { v <- substitution_patterns$ts_tv_ratio[bins == levels(bins)[i] & is.finite(substitution_patterns$ts_tv_ratio)]; data.frame(identity_bin = levels(bins)[i], identity_midpoint = i - .5, number_of_pairs = length(v), median_ts_tv = if(length(v)) median(v) else NA_real_, lower_quartile = if(length(v)) unname(quantile(v, .25)) else NA_real_, upper_quartile = if(length(v)) unname(quantile(v, .75)) else NA_real_, included = length(v) >= 100L) }))
write.table(ratio_summary_all, file.path(output_dir, "ts_tv_ratio_by_identity_bin.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
ratio_summary <- ratio_summary_all[ratio_summary_all$included, , drop = FALSE]
plot_ratio <- ggplot(substitution_patterns[is.finite(substitution_patterns$ts_tv_ratio), ], aes(identity_percentage, ts_tv_ratio)) + geom_point(alpha = .12, colour = "#0072B2", size = .7) + geom_ribbon(data = ratio_summary, aes(x = identity_midpoint, ymin = lower_quartile, ymax = upper_quartile), inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = .25, fill = "#D55E00") + geom_line(data = ratio_summary, aes(x = identity_midpoint, y = median_ts_tv), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "#D55E00", linewidth = .8) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 100), expand = c(0, .01)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .05))) + labs(x = "Pairwise nucleotide sequence identity (%)", y = "Transition/transversion ratio (Ts/Tv)") + theme_plot + theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "transition_transversion_ratio.png"), plot_ratio, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "transition_transversion_ratio_zoom.png"), plot_ratio + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 10)), width = plot_width, height = plot_height, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")

plot_k2p <- ggplot(substitution_patterns[is.finite(substitution_patterns$k2p_distance), ], aes(observed_divergence, k2p_distance)) + geom_point(alpha = .12, colour = "#009E73", size = .7) + geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .02))) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .05))) + labs(x = "Observed nucleotide divergence", y = "K2P distance (substitutions/site)") + theme_plot + theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "observed_divergence_vs_k2p.png"), plot_k2p, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
#| label: create-heatmap-and-histogram
id_genomes <- unique(c(identity_table$genome_group_id_1, identity_table$genome_group_id_2))
id_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, number_genomes, number_genomes, dimnames = list(id_genomes, id_genomes)); a <- match(identity_table$genome_group_id_1, id_genomes); b <- match(identity_table$genome_group_id_2, id_genomes); id_matrix[cbind(a,b)] <- identity_table$identity_percentage; id_matrix[cbind(b,a)] <- identity_table$identity_percentage; diag(id_matrix) <- 100
if (anyNA(id_matrix) || !isTRUE(all.equal(id_matrix, t(id_matrix)))) stop("Identity matrix is incomplete or asymmetric.", call. = FALSE)
ord <- hclust(as.dist(100 - id_matrix), method = "complete")$order
k2p_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, number_genomes, number_genomes, dimnames = list(id_genomes, id_genomes)); a <- match(substitution_patterns$genome_group_id_1, id_genomes); b <- match(substitution_patterns$genome_group_id_2, id_genomes); k2p_matrix[cbind(a,b)] <- substitution_patterns$k2p_distance; k2p_matrix[cbind(b,a)] <- substitution_patterns$k2p_distance; diag(k2p_matrix) <- 0; k2p_matrix <- k2p_matrix[ord, ord]
if (!isTRUE(all.equal(k2p_matrix, t(k2p_matrix)))) stop("K2P matrix is asymmetric.", call. = FALSE)
hm <- expand.grid(row = seq_len(number_genomes), column = seq_len(number_genomes)); hm$value <- c(k2p_matrix); lim <- range(substitution_patterns$k2p_distance, na.rm = TRUE)
k2p_heatmap <- ggplot(hm, aes(column, row, fill = value)) + geom_raster() + scale_fill_gradientn(colours = rev(c("#2166AC", "#67A9CF", "#D1E5F0", "#F7F7F7", "#A6DBA0", "#009E73")), limits = lim, na.value = "#D9D9D9", name = "K2P distance\n(substitutions/site)") + scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), breaks = NULL) + scale_y_reverse(expand = c(0,0), breaks = NULL) + coord_fixed() + theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") + theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(), legend.title = element_text(size = 12), legend.text = element_text(size = 10))
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "three_genes_pairwise_k2p_heatmap.png"), k2p_heatmap, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")

px_candidates <- genome_ids[grepl("PX739045", genome_ids, fixed = TRUE)]
if (length(px_candidates) != 1L) stop("PX739045 is not represented by exactly one concatenated FASTA header.", call. = FALSE)
px_sequence_name <- px_candidates[[1L]]
ordered_genomes <- id_genomes[ord]
px_row_index <- match(px_sequence_name, ordered_genomes)
if (is.na(px_row_index)) stop("PX739045 is absent from the displayed three-gene heatmap order.", call. = FALSE)

marked_k2p_heatmap <- k2p_heatmap +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, number_genomes + 0.5), breaks = NULL) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = data.frame(
      x = c(0.08, 0.08, 0.45),
      y = c(px_row_index - 0.35, px_row_index + 0.35, px_row_index)
    ),
    aes(x = x, y = y), inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#E41A1C", colour = "#E41A1C"
  )
marked_heatmap_path <- file.path(figure_dir, "three_genes_pairwise_k2p_heatmap_PX739045_marked.png")
ggsave(marked_heatmap_path, marked_k2p_heatmap, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
if (!file.exists(marked_heatmap_path) || file.info(marked_heatmap_path)$size <= 0) stop("The marked PX739045 heatmap was not created.", call. = FALSE)
marked_heatmap_validation <- data.frame(
  sequence_name = px_sequence_name,
  displayed_row_index = px_row_index,
  number_of_genomes = length(ordered_genomes),
  output_path = marked_heatmap_path,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
marked_heatmap_validation
values <- substitution_patterns$k2p_distance[is.finite(substitution_patterns$k2p_distance)]; bw <- .01; maxv <- max(values); breaks <- seq(0, ceiling(maxv / bw) * bw, by = bw); counts <- hist(values, breaks = breaks, right = TRUE, include.lowest = TRUE, plot = FALSE)$counts
if (sum(counts) != length(values)) stop("K2P histogram counts do not sum to valid distances.", call. = FALSE)
hist_plot <- ggplot(data.frame(k2p_distance = values), aes(k2p_distance)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = bw, boundary = 0, closed = "right", fill = "grey70", colour = "black") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, maxv), expand = c(0,0)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(counts)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0,.05))) + labs(x = "K2P distance (substitutions/site)", y = "Frequency") + theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") + theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14), axis.title = element_text(size = 14))
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "three_genes_pairwise_k2p_histogram_grey.png"), hist_plot, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
hist_colour <- hist_plot + geom_histogram(aes(fill = after_stat((xmin + xmax) / 2)), binwidth = bw, boundary = 0, closed = "right", colour = "black") + scale_fill_gradientn(colours = rev(c("#2166AC", "#67A9CF", "#D1E5F0", "#F7F7F7", "#A6DBA0", "#009E73")), limits = lim, guide = "none")
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "three_genes_pairwise_k2p_histogram_colored.png"), hist_colour, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
```

## Summary and final validation

```{r}
#| label: write-summary-and-validate-outputs
summary_table <- data.frame(number_of_genomes = number_genomes, number_of_pairwise_comparisons = nrow(substitution_patterns), number_of_valid_k2p_distances = sum(is.finite(substitution_patterns$k2p_distance)), number_of_undefined_k2p_distances = sum(!is.finite(substitution_patterns$k2p_distance)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.table(summary_table, file.path(output_dir, "substitution_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
expected <- c("pairwise_substitution_patterns.tsv", "substitution_summary.tsv", "ts_tv_ratio_by_identity_bin.tsv")
figures <- c("transitions_transversions.png", "transitions_transversions_zoom.png", "transition_transversion_ratio.png", "transition_transversion_ratio_zoom.png", "observed_divergence_vs_k2p.png", "three_genes_pairwise_k2p_heatmap.png", "three_genes_pairwise_k2p_heatmap_PX739045_marked.png", "three_genes_pairwise_k2p_histogram_colored.png", "three_genes_pairwise_k2p_histogram_grey.png")
if (!all(file.exists(file.path(output_dir, expected))) || !all(file.exists(file.path(figure_dir, figures)))) stop("One or more output files are missing.", call. = FALSE)
if (any(file.info(file.path(output_dir, expected))$size <= 0) || any(file.info(file.path(figure_dir, figures))$size <= 0)) stop("One or more output files are empty.", call. = FALSE)
summary_table
```

The old step-04 table is compared after rendering by the project validation
run; this document does not overwrite it. `05_species_demarcation.qmd` still
reads `results/substitution_patterns/pairwise_substitution_patterns.tsv` and
would need an explicit input-path decision before it can consume this
dataset-specific output.
